title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0494
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0494
SSH Pre-Authentication Rekey State Bypass Vulnerability in MikroTik RouterOS
Original Issue Date:October   09, 2026
Severity Rating: MEDIUM
Software Affected
MikroTik RouterOS 6.0.0 to versions below 6.49.21
MikroTik RouterOS 7.0.0 to versions below 7.23.4
MikroTik RouterOS 7.24 to versions below 7.24.2
Overview
A pre-authentication rekey state bypass vulnerability has been reported in MikroTik RouterOS which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass the expected SSH authentication workflow, open a session channel and send an execution request on affected devices.
Target Audience:
Organizations and network administrators using affected MikroTik RouterOS devices.
Risk Assessment:
Risk of unauthorized operations within the RouterOS managed file namespace, including creation, overwriting and reconstruction of files containing configuration and diagnostic information.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for unauthorized file creation, modification or reconstruction, including files containing configuration and diagnostic information, and unauthorized operations on affected RouterOS devices.
Description
MikroTik RouterOS is an operating system used in MikroTik networking devices. It provides routing, network management and remote administration capabilities, including administration through the SSH protocol.
A pre-authentication rekey state bypass vulnerability exists in the SSH implementation of affected MikroTik RouterOS versions due to improper enforcement of the expected authentication workflow. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to open a session channel and send an execution request without completing user authentication.
Successful exploitation of this vulnerability, could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform unauthorized operations within the RouterOS managed file namespace, including creation, overwriting and reconstruction of files containing configuration and diagnostic information.
Solution
Apply appropriate security updates and mitigations as recommended below:
https://mikrotik.com/support
